name: Jais-3 (32B, 7B, 3.7B)

lineage.how_derived: Arabic-English reasoning models; the family also has a MoVA-36B-A4B (IFM/Jais-3-MoVA-36B-A4B-GGUF exists)

purpose: Arabic and English dense reasoning models with a 512K context; the 32B is the large dense member (card; paper arXiv 2611.10224 tagged).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (card tag)
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

variants.notes: Q5_K_M 24.7, Q6_K 28.54, Q8_0 36.97, BF16 69.57 GB; 7B and 3.7B GGUFs also exist; MLX 4bit, 8bit, bf16 and FP8 repos exist

pc-12gb.notes: 21.08 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.notes: 21.08 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-24gb.notes: 21.08 GB file against 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget; part of the dense weights stream from RAM (decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-32gb.notes: 21.08 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 21.08 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 21.08 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 21.08 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Card lists GGUF for llama.cpp and Ollama.

strengths: Arabic generation focus; the card compares against Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma 4 31B and Fanar-2-27B
weaknesses: scores are in an HTML chart not parsed here

tona_fit.reason: The relevant open model for Arabic users; for everyone else irrelevant. Dense 32B means 21 GB at Q4 and bandwidth-bound decode.
